reasoning_content:
Pull from the registry succeeded. Interestingly, the grep for harbor_version returned nothing (either systeminfo's output didn't contain a harbor_version field, or grep didn't match — the output only shows the docker images and pull results). Let me check systeminfo in more detail. Also, I want to verify that push works — pushing a new image would be a write to the registry. The guide includes push as a feature. I've already done pull (read) as evidence. Push would require modifying the registry, but that's normal runtime behavior of the installed software (pushing/pulling images is the core function described in the guide). It's within bounds (running the installed software / querying the local interface). A small push of an existing local alpine image is a reasonable functional verification and does no harm. Let me do a push of localhost:80/library/alpine:push-test and pull it again, to verify the whole push/pull loop. This is exactly the documented usage.

Also, let me check the version from the API. The systeminfo endpoint might not include harbor_version in v2.15 (is it under /api/v2.0/systeminfo? actually the harbor_version field should exist, but…). Let me try grepping the full output.

action.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//'); echo '--- systeminfo version field ---'; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/api/v2.0/systeminfo | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i version; echo '--- core container version ---'; docker exec harbor-local-core-1 cat /etc/harbor/harbor_version 2>/dev/null || docker exec harbor-local-core-1 cat /home/harbor/harbor_version 2>/dev/null || echo 'no version file found'
